name: Fetch Test Users
description: Read user stories to extract required roles, then fetch matching users from the configured database or collect them manually. Saves test users to config.yaml.

inputs.stories: optional — one or more story file paths to extract roles from
inputs.role: optional — comma-separated role names to filter by (overrides story analysis)

outputs.rolesNeeded: string[] — roles extracted from user stories
outputs.usersFound: object[] — { role, username, password, notes } fetched from DB
outputs.source: db | no-db | db-error — how users were obtained
